leadText:
Jon Dickson (Japanese: トシヤ Toshiya) is a character of the day who appeared in Johto Photo Finish. He is a Pokémon Trainer from Sento Cherry Town.

Jon was a competitor in the Silver Conference. He made it all the way to the semifinals, where he battled . After defeating Harrison, he went on to win the finals. His Championship Trophy was given to him by Mr. Goodshow.

==Trivia==
